user.title: Set up Orphan Cleaner
user.description: Orphan Cleaner needs no further settings. Click Submit to enable the sidebar panel and services.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Orphan Cleaner is already set up. Only one instance is supported.

scan.name: Scan for orphans
scan.description: Scan the entity registry for orphaned entities.

strict_mode.name: Strict mode
strict_mode.description: Also flag entities that have a platform but no device_id as a warning, even if otherwise linked.

min_orphan_age_hours.name: Minimum orphan age (hours)
min_orphan_age_hours.description: Only report entities as orphaned once they have been orphaned for at least this many hours. Helps avoid false positives right after a restart.

aggressive_heuristic.name: Aggressive heuristic
aggressive_heuristic.description: Also flag entities that were manually disabled and have not been modified for at least the minimum orphan age. Higher false-positive risk than the default detection.

export_results.name: Export results
export_results.description: Export stored scan results as JSON.

backup_results.name: Backup results
backup_results.description: Create a backup of the current scan results.

get_allowlist.name: Get allowlist
get_allowlist.description: Return the current allowlist of protected entities (for debugging).
